Meta Test Description: USB host-mode enumeration of a low-speed device using xHCI host controller. Configures PHY, reads capability parameters, sets up DCBAA, Command Ring, Event Ring, enables interrupts, performs port connect detection, port reset, Enable Slot, Address Device commands, and GET_DESCRIPTOR control transfer.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure:
1. nic_programming() and GIC_EnableAllIRQ()
2. Configure PHY at MIZAR_USB_BASE+0xc200
3. Read HCSPARAMS1, SUPTPRT2_DW2, SUPTPRT3_DW2
4. Configure PORTSC_20 with WCE/WDE/WOE
5. Read DBOFF, configure CONFIG
6. Set DCBAAP_LO/HI, CRCR_LO/HI
7. Configure ERSTSZ, ERDP, ERSTBA, IMOD, IMAN
8. Write Enable Slot Command TRB
9. Enable system interrupt, start host controller
10. Wait for port connect interrupt
11. Port reset sequence
12. Populate Input Context, Address Device Command
13. Ring doorbell, wait for completion
14. Call enumeration() for GET_DESCRIPTOR
